title: OrphanRecoveryDecision
description: One row appended to <workspace>/logs/orphan-recoveries.jsonl by the boot-time StaleProgressArchiver. Records what happened to each candidate folder in 3-progress (and to historical 3a-failed-pickup folders the boot drain empties). ADR-0051 (failed-pickup elimination, supersedes ADR-0028/0029): a stale folder is no longer surfaced in 3a-failed-pickup. A folder that still has job.json is a real task and is requeued to 2-ready ('requeued-to-ready'); a folder with no job.json is debris and is archived to 7-archive ('archived-debris'); a folder whose tail carries a completion sentinel is recovered to 4-auto-review ('recovered-to-review'); a leftover from an already-completed lane move is silently removed ('mid-move-casualty-removed'). The legacy 'moved-to-failed-pickup' / 'move-to-failed-pickup-failed' kinds are retained only so old on-disk rows still validate. Pairs with the crash-recovery doctrine (ADR-0020): crash-recovery rescues file changes, this sweep rescues the lane shape so the one-task-per-project promise holds visually.

at.description: UTC timestamp at which the sweep made the decision.

kind.description: Outcome class. The 'fresh' and 'skipped' transient verdicts are not persisted; only actionable outcomes land in the JSONL. ADR-0051 routings: 'requeued-to-ready' (real task back to 2-ready), 'archived-debris' (no-job.json folder to 7-archive), 'recovered-to-review' (completion sentinel found, to 4-auto-review), 'mid-move-casualty-removed' (already-moved-lane leftover deleted), plus their '*-failed' counterparts. 'moved-to-failed-pickup' / 'move-to-failed-pickup-failed' are the retired ADR-0028 dead-letter kinds, kept only so old on-disk rows still validate.

projectName.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths and runner status.

slug.description: Original folder slug under 3-progress at the time of the sweep.

jobId.description: Job id read from job.json when present; usually equal to the folder slug.

failedPickupSlug.description: Legacy ADR-0028 field. Slug under 3a-failed-pickup after a dead-letter move. Only present on retired 'moved-to-failed-pickup' rows; null under the ADR-0051 routings (the folder keeps its slug as it moves to 2-ready / 7-archive).

failureKind.description: Legacy ADR-0028 field. Which boot-sweep verdict produced a dead-letter move. Set only on retired 'moved-to-failed-pickup' rows; null under ADR-0051.

targetState.description: Destination state folder. Only set on successful moves: '2-ready' (requeued-to-ready), '4-auto-review' (recovered-to-review), '7-archive' (archived-debris). '3a-failed-pickup' appears only on retired ADR-0028 rows.

sentinelKeyword.description: Completion sentinel found in the last 50 lines of cli-output.log. Set on recovered-to-review and recovery-failed.

ageSeconds.description: Folder age at the time of the sweep, in seconds. Recorded for diagnostic verdicts only.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the verdict; surfaces in the structured backend log line.
